title.narrative: Ecosystems based climate adaptation project (ECAP)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to build local socioeconomic resilience to climate change in vulnerable communities in the northern parts of Fiji. Specific objectives: 1. Strengthen the capacity of local-level CSOs to build an inclusive and integrated enabling environment for addressing issues of climate change at the local level; 2. Support communities to identify, resource, implement and monitor resilient economies focussed on utilising ecosystems assets; 3. Generate and share new knowledge related to climate resilient local economies
